messages.subject: Maritime Quarter — completion
messages.plaintextBody: Marcus, James — glad this has completed. It's been a good asset for us and I'm pleased it's going to a long-term holder. Diane will send the managing agent handover pack to Thornbury's team next week. Best, Hugh Glennister, Glennister Estates
